name: galaxy-tools: an oversized result is saved in memory and read back with galaxy_read_output
description: The Galaxy tools are galaxy-ops operations registered in-process under bare names. Over 20 KiB the in-process wrapper keeps the full envelope in a session-only memory ring and shows the model an overview with the [loom Galaxy output] marker and an outputId for galaxy_read_output. get_iwc_workflows' default page (20 workflows from the fixed IWC manifest, about 29 KB, with no dependency on the Galaxy server's own catalog) crosses that cap, and the bare preview shows /data only as an omitted 20-item array, so the last workflow's trsID and step_count can only come from galaxy_read_output. detailsPresent pins the spill's outputId and textContains pins the marker, so the scenario fails on the wiring even if a model gets the answer some other way. The chat check matches the trsID's shape rather than a value, because the manifest drifts.
inputs: Call get_iwc_workflows once with its default page (do not pass limit or offset). From that page, tell me the trsID and step_count of the LAST workflow listed. Don't plan anything or write to the notebook.
